title: Figure 41: imaginary acoustic pressure vs radial distance, 1000 Hz radiating sphere
description: ANSYS 12.1 line graph of the steady-state imaginary component of pressure (Pa) versus radial distance (m) for 1,000 Hz with 25 elements per wavelength in water, uniformly radiating sphere EPW=25. Decaying oscillation overlaying ANSYS solution with theory. Part of the BAASS acoustic model validation.
